name: hbm_pdie_ucie_colb
landed_note: HBM-UCIE9 10-21: lp.py landed column from the wires-only flat parent ot_pdie_ucie_col_flat (spec tools/landed_parent/specs/ot_pdie_ucie_col.json), 3 regions, 0 landings: core PLL clk -> two regional roots ck_tx (tx face reg, live flag, PMA TX) and ck_rx (rate-matcher read side, SRAM read, status, rx/st out regs) that share no net; the far die's forwarded pma_rck -> ck_rck (PMA RX + its output register u_prr, rate-matcher write side, SRAM write). The only rck->rx crossings are the CDC children u_rm + u_rmm and u_sts. related_same_frequency is the landed-cluster STA convention (as s81lk_rate_match / s81lk_serdes_col_lp6).

reset_landing.reason: regional_reset_ports: each region's reset port rst_<r> is landed 2 registered stages on that region's own clock beside its pin by lp.py; no plain fanout from a port, no cross-region reset path

layer_cap_grant: DRIVE-HBM (HBM die lead; delegated to HBM-UCIE8 10-20): UCIe column with 2,055 pins and M5-PG PMA hard abstracts (macro PG = M5 stripes, s81_pma_gen v1.1 LEF): the tile needs an M6 strap over them (ucie1 gate 22:07 PDN-0233: macro_m5 grid M5-M6 had no M6 in an M5-cap tile); same strap need as the S81 SerDes column (PG M7). Die signals keep M7+ over the column.

pin_regs.reason: two-clock CDC leaf: the recipe pin register is single-clock and cannot serve both domains; the RTL already registers every pin in its own domain: tx -> u_txf face reg (ck_tx), rx/st <- 2-stage out regs u_lpo_rx/u_lpo_st (ck_rx), rst_tx/rst_rx/rst_rck landed 2 stages on their region clock, pma_tx/pma_tck launched and pma_rx captured by the registered boundary of the PMA hard abstracts (ck_tx / ck_rck; PMA RX q re-registered by u_prr on ck_rck)

hold_budget_reason: two-clock CDC leaf (as the closed s81lk_rate_match tile): core pins registered in the RTL (tx face reg u_txf, 2-stage rx/st out regs u_lpo_*, reset ports landed 2 stages), PMA pads registered inside the hard abstracts; boundary hold budget stays the tile's
structural_change: HBM-UCIE9 10-21 structural successor of the ucie2 gate FAIL (ref_gate *-20261020-223234: main GRT stop on ONE ck_core root over the tx AND rx pin groups, boundary pin-flop spread 88.8 TT; fallback CTS FF spread 107.2; cross-clock -306.7 ps u_prx/q -> u_rm comb -> u_rmm/w_ce_in, an unregistered macro->macro path): (1) PMA RX output register u_prr (513 b, ck_rck) beside the rxm before the rate matcher (+1 pma_rck edge ahead of the elastic rate matcher, priced); (2) ck_core split into regional roots ck_tx (512 tx pin regs + PMA TX) and ck_rx (1,028 rx/st out regs + rate-matcher read side + SRAM read), each with its own landed reset port; the two share no net, so no landing ring is needed (0 added edges). Method of s81lk_serdes_col_lp6 (claude/s81-serdes6-1020 41cccbc13): PMA tx/rx hard abstracts ot_ucie_pma_{txm,rxm} (513 b, 108.0 x 1252.8, tools/mem_compiler/ucie_pma_gen.py; rxm clock pin on its digital face so the rck tree stays in the digital band), rate matcher ot_s81_rate_match_sr + dual-clock SRAM ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x546_m1, regional clock/reset ports ck_core/rst_core, ck_rck/rst_rck (reset landed 2 stages per region). FALLBACK (parallel): 259.2 x 1641.6 = fits the existing host_N slot (260.928 x 1653.48) without a re-grant; PMA rxm at x 10.8, txm at 140.4 (off the 43.2 lattice, WAIVED: guidance under the 09:35 rule freeze), 21.6 channel; all core pins on the N face (W/E pinless)

job.purpose: HBM host UCIe column hbm_pdie_ucie_colb: ot_pdie_ucie_col (PMA abstracts + SRAM rate matcher + regional clocks/resets) for HBM die host_N, gate --cts

cdc_note: rate matcher = control u_rm (ot_s81_rate_match_sr, soft CDC child: write side ck_rck, read side ck_rx, 2-stage gray syncs) + storage u_rmm = dual-clock SRAM ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x546_m1 (raw macro sink of BOTH roots: wclk ck_rck, rclk ck_rx). PMA RX q is registered by u_prr (ck_rck) beside the rxm before every rate-matcher / SRAM-write / status cone. Status sync u_sts soft CDC child (ck_r ck_rck, ck_t ck_rx). ck_tx and ck_rx share no net (no crossing).
